scope: Three purposively selected URLs actually cited in frozen Stage 4 answers; descriptive source audit, not a causal test or a whole-site quality rating.
access_method: Web retrieval tool original-page reads; tool responses may use crawled representations, so this is not a direct browser/network or historical-snapshot verification.

selected_pages.title: GEO Field Manual: The Complete Practitioner Guide
selected_pages.selection_reason: Own-site answer-body citation in two new Q3 answers; recheck the prior audit concern.
selected_pages.byline: Copyright and author footer identify Artur Ferreira; Edition 1.2, August 2026.

evidence.locator: Edition note; Chapter 12, Platform/Results; Chapter Summary
evidence.observation: Revision note acknowledges earlier transcription errors. Yet Chapter 12 still specifies 15 queries × 5 runs = 75 per version, alongside results 18/30 versus 11/30, z=1.81, p=.07, and later says significantly outperforms.
The reported test concerns one topic and Perplexity; it is not a ChatGPT–Grok experiment.

selected_pages.content_strategy: Comprehensive reference with chapter anchors, checklists, worked rewrites and experiment-log links.
reusable: Separate reference pages from experiment logs; publish version notes.
limitations: The method/result denominator conflict remains unresolved in this page. p=.07 does not meet a conventional .05 threshold; the significance wording needs qualification. No raw-data replication or exact-page independent citation established.

selected_pages.title: Free GEO Ebooks & Guides | The GEO Lab
selected_pages.selection_reason: Library hub actually cited in both creator and free-learning questions.
selected_pages.byline: About These Guides and author footer attribute the guides to Artur Ferreira.

evidence.observation: A task-based library links fundamentals, framework, experiments, workbook and technical guides, then explains starting choices and update versions.
The page describes browser-print PDF saving and also Gumroad zero-price checkout requiring email. Download/checkout was not tested.

selected_pages.content_strategy: A discoverable hub turns individual guides into an explicit learning sequence with audience-specific entry points.
reusable: Create one public index with task labels, suggested reading order and authorship.
limitations: This index supplies no new experimental sample. Its claimed proven framework is promotional characterization, not validation by this audit. Independent citations of this exact hub were not verified.

selected_pages.title: GEO Experiments: Design, Measure & Learn — 2026 Edition
selected_pages.selection_reason: Own-site body citation returned by the API Q3 answer.
selected_pages.byline: Embedded guide explicitly identifies Artur Ferreira and a 2026 edition.

evidence.locator: Live Data; How The GEO Lab Runs Experiments
evidence.observation: Headline reports 330 queries across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity; a separate results table links studies, including E001 (18/30 vs 11/30, p=.07) and a 480-query FAQ null result. These are different studies, not one combined sample.
Provides exact-query, date, engine, citation URL and quoted-passage fields; its example uses ten queries across three engines.

selected_pages.content_strategy: Hypothesis-to-report workflow, ten test templates and a table linking conclusions to individual studies.
reusable: Publish a blank measurement sheet and distinguish templates from completed results.
background_advantages: Multiple existing studies and a proprietary Console.
limitations: No Grok appears in the 330-query headline. Underlying datasets were not independently reanalysed. Independent citations of this exact guide were not verified.

distribution_search.purpose: Locate observable off-site distribution; no exhaustive backlink or audience audit.

distribution_checks.evidence: Author announces a recurring 14-experiment series, using measurement, tools, results and defensible conclusion as the post format. This is self-distribution, not independent endorsement.

Synapse lists a related paper by Artur Ferreira and Julio Arévalo Piedra and links DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23122087. It republishes the authors’ abstract; this verifies external indexing, not independent confirmation or a citation of the selected guides.
Search excerpt named Artur as a joint researcher; the opened page instead displayed Julio-focused material without that attribution. Excluded as corroborated independent distribution.

background_source.evidence: Author reports over twenty years in SEO, a separate web-design business and existing tooling. These are background advantages and self-reports, not audited credentials or causes of AI recommendation.

notes: All 18 holdout answers were already frozen before this source audit; no test prompt, model call or source recommendation was added.
The current manual explicitly acknowledges corrections, but a method/result mismatch and significance wording remain within the inspected edition. Preserve both observations together.
Page-level attribution is checked from author/footer material. Search ranking, backlink quantity, audience size and referral/conversion outcomes were not measured.

hypotheses.idea: A task-based hub may help users and retrieval systems locate the right experiment or practical guide.
hypotheses.future_test: Compare a pre-registered, URL-free prompt bank before and after adding a hub; repeat observations and retain a control where feasible.

hypotheses.idea: Linking concise conclusions to versioned protocols, data and correction notes may improve inspectability.
hypotheses.future_test: Measure retrieval, citation, explicit mention and recommendation separately after a controlled evidence-page change.

shortfalls: Independent third-party citations of the three exact selected pages were not verified within one focused search.
No original data replication, download/checkout, browser rendering, backlink inventory or creator business impact was measured.
These selected visible creators have no matched un-recommended control group; observed features cannot explain why an AI chose them.
